verdict.rationale: Clara's public API docs explicitly cover creating, updating, locking/unlocking and deleting cards. They also document virtual card creation, limit periodicity, updates to configurations while a card is locked, and a Card Configurations API for time, day and merchant-category controls, which covers every element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the card-management endpoints (the probes only confirm the docs and OpenAPI schema exist).

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API

citations.quote: Create, update, lock/unlock, and delete cards.
`"VIRTUAL"` creates a virtual card, active immediately (no activation step needed).
`periodicity`: `"MONTHLY"`, `"WEEKLY"`, or `"DAILY"` — determines when the limit resets
Lock card: Must be active (card locked - Configurations and threshold can still be updated).
Use the Card Configurations API to add time, day-of-week, or merchant category restrictions. All fields are optional and can be combined.
